headline: Sammaan Capital Limited confirms timely interest payment on listed secured redeemable non-convertible debentures
sum: Sammaan Capital Limited filed an exchange intimation under SEBI Regulation 57 confirming timely payment of interest on its Secured Redeemable Non-Convertible Debentures issued via public issue and listed on NSE. The certification serves as regulatory compliance disclosure required under the LODR framework.
detail: Sammaan Capital Limited, a financial services company, issued Secured Redeemable Non-Convertible Debentures via public offering and listed them on NSE. On 25 June 2026, the company filed a formal intimation with NSE certifying compliance with interest payment obligations on those debentures. This disclosure is mandated under SEBI (Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015, Regulation 57, which requires listed entities to promptly disclose material corporate actions, including interest/dividend payments, to the exchange.
